_note: The only values a code may carry in these columns. Adding a value is a deliberate change: add it here, and the index check accepts it everywhere.

_streams.electronics: Counts toward HStat's electronics trade figures (front page totals, shares, segments, rankings). The FED electronics sector definition: every baseline code. A new code joins only by an explicit decision.
_streams.electronics-inputs: Materials, consumables, tooling and machinery used to make electronics (SPECS-type coverage). Own pages and own totals; never added into electronics figures.
_streams.other: Wider trade coverage with no electronics role claimed. Own pages; never added into electronics figures. The default for an upload that does not say.
_streams.capital-goods: Capital goods (machinery and equipment for production): the FED capital goods segment. Own pages and own totals; never added into electronics figures. The segment's full list, including capital goods already carried in another stream, is hs_index/sectors/capital-goods/codes.csv.
